name: Wholey- HomeRoots Dropshipping
author: HomeRoots

sections.installation:
How to Install?

  1. Upload Homeroots.zip via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins menu.
  3. Map HomeRoots categories to your store’s categories.
  4. Select the products you want to import and add them to your store!
  5. DO NOT FORGET >> Configure the settings to set your markup, choose a shipping method (including HomeRoots), and manage sync options.
sections.description:
About Us

Brought to you by HomeRoots – Effortlessly infuse a wide variety of Home products, product details, inventory, and product prices for hassle-free dropshipping across the US. This ensures that your store remains continuously synchronized, maintaining up-to-date information across various channels. Homeroots will keep your products up-to-date in all aspects, and once a product is purchased, we take care of the shipment from A to Z.

✔ Endless options of quality Home Furnishing products
✔ Set Your Own Markups
✔ Hassle-Free Shipping – We do it for you
✔ Customer Support 7 Days a Week
✔ Inventory + Products+ Pricing sync
✔ Full Plan- We pull, ship orders, and update your store with tracking numbers

eCom Ready Content in Seconds

Content is King. Creating products content is a headache!
The struggle of organizing, presenting, and maintaining this valuable information is real.
Wholey solves the challenge of content creation by automating the generation of compelling product data. Imagine the positive impact on your business and bottom line.

Operations Management

We streamline all orders, shipping, and invoicing into one single dashboard that is intuitive and easy to use!

Wholey provides a comprehensive synchronization between the platforms you sell on like WooCommerce, enabling you to manage all your operations in one place. Utilizing Wholey and HomeRoots will allow you to cut your internal operational expenses, eliminating your need to have multiple team members for each sales channel and activity.

Support

Need Technical Help with the App?

Email integrations@homeroots.co for technical support.

Need Help With Orders?

Email cs@homeroots.co for customer support.

Make sure to include your account email and the platform you’re using (e.g. WooCommerce) in your message, as we have apps on different platforms.
Visit our website
